translations.seg-0002: Hi! So what are we talking about today?
translations.seg-0003: I want to talk about a little pebble I picked up on my way home from work.
translations.seg-0004: A pebble? That sounds kind of interesting.
translations.seg-0005: It's really round and smooth, and it feels cool in your hand.
translations.seg-0006: How did you end up noticing it?
translations.seg-0007: Because that day I was walking slowly and wasn't looking at my phone.
translations.seg-0008: When you slow down, it seems like you notice more things.
translations.seg-0009: Right, so I put it on my desk.
translations.seg-0010: OK, that's all for today. See you next time!
